description: This file defines an interface 'FineractEntityAccessWriteService' which declares methods related to creating, updating, deleting, and adding entity access and mappings within the Fineract infrastructure. It serves as a contract for implementing classes that handle entity access modifications.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessWriteService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing entity access and mappings in the Fineract system.

methods.name: createEntityAccess
methods.description: Creates a new entity access entry based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: createEntityToEntityMapping
methods.description: Creates a mapping between entities identified by a relationship ID and a JSON command.

methods.name: updateEntityToEntityMapping
methods.description: Updates an existing entity-to-entity mapping identified by mapId using the provided JSON command.

methods.name: deleteEntityToEntityMapping
methods.description: Deletes an entity-to-entity mapping identified by mapId.

methods.name: addNewEntityAccess
methods.description: Adds new access permissions for a specified entity, defining its access type and related entity.
